svg.title: Three synthetic field candidates and their means
svg.desc: Original exact heat reference, a synthetic additive-bias candidate and a spatial-mean-only candidate. All preserve their own mean, but the biased candidate violates the prescribed initial mean and the mean-only candidate discards spatial structure. These are teaching counterexamples, not learned or patient outputs.
